Meta.title: ARASILVER — Handcrafted Silver Jewellery
Meta.description: ARASILVER — handcrafted jewellery in 925 sterling silver. Rings, earrings, pendants and bracelets, made by hand with love for detail.

Hero.lede: ARASILVER is a small jewellery atelier. We craft original pieces in 925 sterling silver, where every detail is thought through and polished by hand.
Hero.heroAlt: A hand wearing ARASILVER silver rings

Editorial.title: Moon above
Editorial.lede: The new collection is an ode to moonlight and the quiet of the coast. Organic shapes, soft curves and matte silver.

About.title: Every piece is
About.p1: ARASILVER began in 2019 as a small atelier where every piece is made by hand from 925 sterling silver. We believe true beauty lives in imperfections — the faint marks of the hammer, organic lines and soft shine.
About.p2: Our collections are minimalist forms inspired by nature and the architecture of ancient cities. We don't make thousands of identical pieces. Every work passes through the master's hands — from sketch to final polish.
About.value1: Only 925 sterling silver, certified at an accredited laboratory.
About.value2: Every piece is crafted in our atelier from start to finish by hand.
About.value3: Lifetime care: cleaning and repairs for pieces purchased from us.

Footer.newsletterLede: Subscribe to be the first to hear about new collections, private sales and special projects.

Shop.lede: Every piece is made by hand from 925 sterling silver. Unique shapes, texture and the master's soul in every detail.
